title: Arvion Commissioned Largest Industrial Zero Liquid Discharge Facility in Western India
summary: The new 20 MLD facility recovers 98.6% of process water and recycles commercial-grade Glauber salts, saving 7 billion liters of regional groundwater annually.
content: Arvion Global today announced the operational commissioning of its newest ultra-high-efficiency Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) plant at its Sanand manufacturing complex. Designed in-house by Arvion Environmental Solutions, the multi-stage system integrates forward-osmosis membranes with mechanical vapor recompression.

title: Advanced Materials Division Signs Supply Pact for Next-Generation Aerospace Composites
summary: Multi-year agreement covers delivery of AS9100D-certified flame-retardant structural pre-pregs for regional commercial aviation nacelles.
content: Arvion Advanced Materials has formalized a strategic agreement with an international aerospace consortium to deliver lightweight carbon-aramid hybrid composite weaves. Deliveries will commence from Arvion's newly expanded cleanroom facility in Bengaluru.

title: Arvion Reports Robust Q2 FY26 Financials: EBITDA Margin Expands to 13.8%
summary: Consolidated quarterly revenues reached ₹2,340 Crore, driven by surging export demand for high-pressure heavy engineering equipment and specialty technical fabrics.
content: The Board of Directors of Arvion Global Industries Limited approved the unaudited financial results for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company registered an EBITDA of ₹318 Cr, with exports contributing 46% of total revenue.

title: Arvion Patents Breakthrough Graphene Nanofiltration Membrane HydroVortex™
summary: Proprietary membrane delivers 40% higher permeate flux and significantly curbs bio-fouling in extreme chemical process streams.
content: The Indian and European Patent Offices have granted full patents for Arvion's HydroVortex™ nanofiltration architecture. The membrane represents four years of collaborative research between Arvion Central R&D and leading materials science institutes.
